feeds.title: Trinity Bible Chapel Pastor's Blog
feeds.description: The Pastor's Blog is a work of Jacob Reaume, featuring articles on being grateful, life lessons, and more. Trinity Bible Chapel is a church that meets in Waterloo, Ontario, and seeks to reach the entire Waterloo Region with the gospel of Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: The Millennial Pastor
feeds.description: I am a Lutheran Pastor born at the tail end of 1982, which places me at the tip of the Millennial Generation. Here you will find my thoughts, stories, and lots of sermons about what it means to be a millennial and a pastor.

feeds.title: NakedPastor Blog
feeds.description: David Hayward, known as the Naked Pastor, transitioned from 30 years in ministry to pursue art. Through NakedPastor, he challenges norms, deconstructs dogma, and offers hope to spiritual refugees. His art reflects the struggles of independent thinkers questioning religion's confines. Explore and purchase his cartoons, apparel, books, and more.

feeds.title: Congregational Christian Churches in Canada Blog
feeds.description: The 4Cs is an evangelical denomination committed to 'Proclaiming Jesus Christ. Making Disciples. Building Healthy Churches'.

feeds.title: Matthew Ruttan Blog
feeds.description: HI! I'm Matthew Ruttan. I'm a disciple-in-progress, husband to Laura, dad-of-three, pastor at Westminster Church in Barrie, Canada. I like to write. Over the past few years, I've had a variety of articles published by Faith Today Magazine, The Toronto Star, The Gospel Coalition Canada, These Days Magazine, The Hamilton Spectator, The Presbyterian Record, The Stream, and The Christian Courier. You can link to some here.

feeds.title: Pastor's - Emmanuel Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: Posts by Chris Hutchison, lead pastor of Emmanuel Baptist Church in Nipawin, SK contributing to the welfare of the community with his blog posts and guiding people moral, spiritual, personal, and religious.

feeds.title: St Bede's Anglican Church » Pastor's Blog
feeds.description: Read the Pastor's Blog from St Bede's Anglican Church, which seeks out kindness and preaches & guides the community with their blog posts on morality, spirituality, religion, and more.

feeds.title: Village Missions of Canada Blog
feeds.description: Village Missions is committed to helping country churches not only survive, but thrive. Since 1968, we have been helping country churches thrive all across Canada. We place pastors in rural churches and help those churches get back on their feet. We care about the country church and are working to keep the church a vibrant and vital presence in more than 30 rural communities throughout Canada.

feeds.title: Knollwood Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: You'll find the latest here from our pastor and other leaders in the church. We're always writing so check back here for the latest updates. At Knollwood Baptist Church we gather together as a whole community to exalt Christ through expository preaching and singing songs that are singable and testify of the richness of Jesus. We seek excellence as we worship through prayer, singing, preaching, tithing, baptism, and communion to the God who deserves our best.

feeds.title: The Bridge Church Abbotsford - Sermon thoughts
feeds.description: Pastor's Blog by The Bridge Online features write-ups and posts on peace, self-love, emotions, values, and virtue for everyone and anyone trying to find righteousness. The Bridge Church is a varied group of people drawn together from many walks of life in Abbotsford and its surrounding areas. Our community is a place where people can learn how to grow spiritually in a brave and healthy way.

feeds.title: Sturgeon Valley Baptist Church/SVBC Blog
feeds.description: Sturgeon Valley Baptist Church (SVBC) is a fellowship of warm, friendly people who have a personal relationship with Jesus Christ, and who are committed to the Bible as God's infallible Word and His fullness for Christian life and service, and to spiritual maturity as the goal of our church fellowship.

feeds.title: Preacher Thoughts
feeds.description: Paul Martin serves as senior pastor at Grace Fellowship Church. Read advice on Preacher Thoughts about living with morality and integrity. You may also find news, events, and information for other preaching-related matters.

feeds.title: Winchester PC - Pastor's Blog
feeds.description: The Winchester United Pastoral Charge is part of the Eastern Ontario Outaouais Region. The EOORC upholds the beliefs of the United Church of Canada. Following the teachings of Jesus Christ, our mission is to offer compassion and love to those in need, to welcome newcomers into our community, and to help people grow in their relationship with God.

feeds.title: North Glengarry Parish » Pastor's Blog
feeds.description: North Glengarry Parish's Pastor's Blog posts guidance articles on mental stability, inner peace, virtue, and more. Our parish began as a mission rooted in inspiring the area we now know as Alexandria to a living faith. The faithful have congregated and celebrated countless baptisms, marriages, confirmation, and ordinations. This place is holy ground and a spot on this earth where Christ's presence has been profoundly experienced.

feeds.title: The Mill Christian Fellowship » Pastor's Desk
feeds.description: Read thoughts and preachings on ethics, justice, principles, and more from The Mill Christian Fellowship's Pastor's Desk. At the Mill Christian Fellowship, our mission is to glorify God through the great commission. We strive to make disciples and teach them the Bible. Through expository preaching, we strive to unwrap the meaning of scripture and the intent of the text provided. Through prayer, service, and witness, our goal is to impact our neighbors in Mississauga for the cause of Christ.

feeds.title: The Pastor's Nanaimo Church of the Nazarene Blog
feeds.description: The Nanaimo Church of the Nazarene is a gathering of people who have experienced the grace of God through faith in Jesus Christ. The purpose of the Nanaimo Church of the Nazarene is to glorify God through worship, developing them into Christ-like maturity, and equipping them for their ministry in the Church and life-mission in the world.

feeds.title: The Wittenberg Door
feeds.description: The Wittenberg Door is a work of Scott Jacobsen, Pastor at Mountain View Christian Church. Creating awareness, helping people, doing right, and more, Scott Jacobsen writes about everything related to staying on the path of value and preaching to his readers to do the same.

feeds.title: Hope Lutheran Church » Rev. Kristain World
feeds.description: Hope Lutheran Church's Rev. Kristain World's blog is a place to reflect consciously, live with empathy, and surround in & spread kindness. Hope Lutheran Church believes in a simple, intimate, and informal service of prayer and quiet reflection. Hope Lutheran is a place to connect, rejoice, or meditate as life hands its challenges and gifts.

feeds.title: The Journey Church » Pastor Sarah's Blog
feeds.description: Follow Pastor Sarah on her blog journey to read and learn from her preachings. The Journey Church's mission is to lead people to follow Jesus, love God, and Love others, and become a church that loves like Jesus.

feeds.title: The Seed
feeds.description: Welcome to The Seed. We are a multicultural, intergenerational worshipping congregation made up of house churches. Our mission is to lead people to become fully devoted followers of Jesus Christ. Our vision is to restore the New Testament church model through house church ministry.

feeds.title: Greenfield Church - Pastor Tyler's Blog
feeds.description: This is a blog of Tyler F. Williams, the Lead Pastor of Greenfield Church, Edmonton, AB featuring news, events, interviews, thoughts, and information from the church. At Greenfield Community Church, we see ourselves as Christ-followers joining God on a mission and growing in our love for God, neighbours, and one another.

feeds.title: Graceway Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: We are Bruce and Donna Cook. Our goal is to provide people with solid answers to life's perplexing questions and improve their personal welfare both spiritually, socially, and with an interest in providing them with a friendly atmosphere of fellowship.
